description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function prototypes for message bus engagement, initialization, resource management, signal sending, and message handling. It is part of the CCSP Secure Software Download environment for embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus for the specified component, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check of the message bus connection or status.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, possibly based on priority.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating that a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating that a transfer is complete.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages on a specific path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the component to the configuration repository or control router.
